name: Bratwurst
siboNotes: Plain bratwurst without high-FODMAP seasonings like garlic or onion is well-tolerated. Check ingredient labels for added wheat, onion powder, or garlic powder which could trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - some brands contain garlic or onion powder
Grill, pan-fry, or boil without adding high-FODMAP seasonings
Choose brands with simple ingredients: pork, salt, and FODMAP-friendly spices
Serve with low-FODMAP condiments like mustard or ketchup (check sugar content)
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
